Medication timing comes only from Table 1 period rows (year ranges overlapping in 2017); doses, routes, durations, indications and individual drug responses are not stated. The narrative lists augmentation agents together while the table places olanzapine and sodium valproate in 2017-2018 and quetiapine in 2020-2023.
Dothiepin is labelled a tetracyclic antidepressant in the case text, while the discussion lists TCAs separately; the source label is preserved unreconciled.

Dates of the revised PDD diagnosis, of DBT completion and of disengagement are not stated; only "shortly after the revised diagnosis" and the "yet another diagnostic change after 12 years" wording order them.
The request for ketamine therapy or ECT is a patient request grouped in the 2024 table row; no administration or decision is documented.
"Type 3" in the PDD diagnosis is not defined in the source.
Absence of drug, alcohol and tobacco use is a current denial; former use is not addressed.
Discussion sentences about guidelines, CBASP, antidepressant efficacy and the Upadhyay screening study are literature, not this patient's care.
Routine investigations were completed "during assessment"; the source does not state which assessment or its order relative to the 2012-2024 labels or the revised PDD diagnosis.
